quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX interim report: 2026 Interim Report (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 cash flow and balance sheet (interim report): net cash used in operating activities RMB2,785,559 thousand (RMB715,589 thousand in H1 2025); cash and cash equivalents RMB2,910.8 million at June 30, 2026 (RMB1,504.7 million at December 31, 2025); trade and bills receivables RMB1,237,704 thousand (RMB576,575 thousand); capital commitments RMB96.5 million (RMB31.3 million), mainly for property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Revenue included RMB14.8 million (1.6%) from semiconductor components, in particular server components, which the company says were originally procured as inventory reserves and sold to certain customers to accommodate their procurement needs (gross loss RMB171,049 thousand); AI computing solutions gross margin fell to 27.7% from 45.7% on more lower-priced solutions. Revenue by region: Chinese mainland RMB930,899 thousand, Hong Kong RMB14,780 thousand. Full-time employees 916 (685 a year earlier); the R&D team comprises over 650 employees.
